name: slopcheck
description: Check a draft X (Twitter) post for slop before it is posted. Free, no API key.
long_description: SlopCheck scores a post from 0 to 100 for how much it reads like the posts people call out as slop: engagement bait, filler, formula. 50 or more reads as slop. It is not an AI detector: it says how a post reads, not who or what wrote it. Without a key the server uses SlopCheck's free API (50 checks a day per IP address). The post text is sent to slopcheck.io to be scored.

api_key.title: SlopCheck Premium API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the free API. With a Premium key (slopcheck.io/developers) the get_feedback tool appears.

tools.name: check_post
tools.description: Score one draft X post for slop, from 0 to 100

tools.name: check_posts
tools.description: Score up to 20 drafts in one call, in order
